description:
Categories and countries covered by Wintraits (valid values of `categoria` and `pais`). Call it first.

`disponibles`: Match categories (`nivel` "match", with `estado_examen`): every Match tool works. `solo_scan`: Scan
categories (snapshot of today's best sellers, with `fecha_datos`): wintraits_scan_perfil (winning attributes),
wintraits_scan_historia, wintraits_chequeo_rapido and wintraits_chequeo_asin. New Scan categories every week.
The data comes from Amazon, but the attributes also help outside Amazon (own shop, other marketplaces, product
design, packaging).

Args:
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
name: wintraits_categorias_disponibles
